text:
alia_cs: Quick short brief for customers with tight budgets + flaky connections. Need a micro-checklist + paste-ready snippets we can email.

alia_cs: TL;DR: 1) prefill 2 starter msgs server-side, 2) prefer 2-3 small batches or concat for single-reply flows, 3) stream only for active typing UX, 4) set soft quota alerts and renewal_watch rules, 5) one-question feedback 1h after first live request.

noah_se: tiny curl + node snippets please, plus header example to mark mobile calls.

alia_cs: added minimal snippets (pasteable):
```
# batch curl (good for queued mobile flush)
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -H \"X-Client-Mode: mobile\" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-small","inputs":["short-summary","title-suggest"],"max_tokens":100,"stream":false}'

# node one-liner: switch to streaming for live typing (pseudo)
await client.generate({model:'redwood-small', input:prompt, stream:true})
```

frank_sre: ops bullets to include in the brief:
- prefix cache TTL: 25s for short sessions, 60s for low-churn enterprise.
- per-tenant concurrency default: 3; reduce to 2 for very constrained plans.
- warm-pool: pre-warm 1 shard for scheduled launches (5min prior).
- fallback: if p50 latency > 350ms for 60s, auto-switch client to batch-only + reduce max_tokens by 25% for mobile header.

alia_cs: renewal/watch rule: set renewal_watch when 7-day avg token use >70% of monthly quota OR 3-day rolling avg >80% and DAU spike >1.8x. When flagged auto-create CS task with last 7d burn chart + mitigation suggestions.

tess_pm: outreach script suggestion (short): \"Hi <name> we see your app	usage is rising near your monthly budget. Can we help with a quick prompt audit or a short burst while you stabilize?\" Keep it friendly.

alia_cs: added outreach copy and a quick mitigation list for CS to offer: 1) concat vs batch review, 2) reduce max_tokens, 3) temporary burst (48h), 4) prompt tweaks.

noah_se: small UX tip for streaming on flaky networks: send an initial 60-char sync prefix (small non-stream call) to get first bytes, then open stream for remainder. Reduces tail latency.

alia_cs: feedback capture snippet (1h after first production request):
```
# simple feedback POST to tenant webhook
curl -X POST https://hooks.customer.com/feedback \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"<TENANT>","nps":"0-10","comment":"one-line"}'
```

notify_bot: Confluence doc created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/micro-budget-connectivity (access: customer-success, product)

alia_cs: If no objections I'll attach this to the low-touch kickoff template and the mobile starter email. Please reply with edits by EOD.
